verdict.rationale: Buzz has voice huddles, and agents can join them, so this story applies. However, the evidence pack never documents transcription, AI-generated meeting notes, or recaps of huddles for attendees or people who missed them. Agent search of chat history is a different capability and does not count toward huddle recaps.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed
